conviction_note: The H1 shortfall against the company plan can be worked out from the Q1 短信 (ordinary profit 43.5% of the H1 plan against a 5-year average of 53.4%), so the miss is mostly priced. What is left is a coin-flip-sized lean: a full-year cut is a real risk, but this company usually defers cuts to April, its H1 prints have historically drifted up (8 of the last 9 at -1% or better), and the 6.5% buyback that ended on 9/16 may be renewed. Findings sum to -0.7. The scaled number is near zero (p_up 48 on a 2.3% scale) because rule 1 moved p_up toward 50 and the two sides of the guidance and capital-return decision roughly offset.
bar: Company H1 plan (unchanged since 2026-05-14 and reaffirmed in the Q1 短信 of 2026-07-30): revenue 15,600m, OP 3,850m, ordinary 4,200m, net 2,900m, interim dividend 75. FY plan 33,700 / 8,950 / 9,700 / 6,700, dividend 150. https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260723598585.pdf . No 四季報 or IFIS number could be reached (shikiho.toyokeizai.net is JS-only; Yahoo JP consensus page errored), so the street bar is unsourced and the findings that depend on it are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register (baseline, as of 2026-10-28): 1.60% across 2 sellers, up from 1.49% (+0.11pt, building slightly). 信用倍率 15.59x on 10/23 (margin long 280.6k shares vs short 18.0k; https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6419), about 5 days of average volume: retail crowded long on a 5% yield stock. No option skew exists. Run-up -2.56% over 20d and -4.74% over 5d, including -2.27% on 10/28 on +63% volume, so holders were already de-risking into the print.

findings.finding: H1 is on course to miss the company's own H1 plan clearly. Q1 ordinary profit of 1,825m was 43.5% of the 4,200m H1 plan, against a 5-year average Q1 share of 53.4%, and Q1 OP of 1,529m was 39.7% of the 3,850m plan. Reaching the plan needs Q2 revenue of 8,806m (+30% on Q1, +9% YoY) and Q2 OP of 2,321m (+52% on Q1), while Q2 has come in below Q1 in two of the last three years. A 業績予想値と実績値との差異 notice on results day is likely, the format this company used on 2021-10-29 and 2022-10-28.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 print (2026-07-30, 43.5% progress): -2.64% the next day. H1 prints over 2017-2025 moved -0.99, +0.93, +0.05, +0.06, +1.21, +3.28, +1.18, +0.64, +0.99 (Yahoo daily bars), including two results-day 差異 notices (2021, 2022) that were followed by +1.21 and +3.28.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: kabutan printed the 43.5% vs 53.4% progress comparison on the day, and the stock fell 2.64%. The unpriced part is the size of the Q2 shortfall. Q1 was -22% revenue and -37% OP YoY, and nothing since has shown the Jul-Sep trend (peers Daikoku and Game Card report in November). If the market were pricing a deeper miss, the stock would sit below its post-Q1 low and shorts would be building faster than +0.11pt.
findings.independence: Peers' Q1 prints point the same way on industry demand: Game Card ordinary -25% (2026-08-06), Daikoku ordinary -34% (2026-08-07), Mamiya OP turned to a loss (2026-08-05). https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6249 . All of these are public from August, so they confirm the trend rather than add to it.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (33,700m revenue, 8,950m OP) implies H2 revenue of about 18,100m+ (+17% YoY on last year's 15,523m H2) and OP of about 5,100m+ (+27% YoY), while H1 is running about 20% down, so the plan looks unreachable. The company's habit, though, is to defer downward full-year cuts to April: in FY2026 it held a 37,500m plan through the H1 and Q3 prints and cut it 14% on 2026-04-13 (stock -5.3%). A cut at this print is a minority outcome; a hold is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-04-13 full-year cut (ordinary -17%) was followed by -5.30% the next day. FY results with a new guide and a buyback on 2026-05-14: +7.72%. H1 2025 with the FY plan held despite an H1 revenue shortfall: +0.99%.
findings.independence: The plan arithmetic comes from the FY26 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260514/140120260424510265.pdf) and kabutan's quarterly table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6419). Same company documents, so it is not independent.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: PER 7.7 on the plan's EPS and PBR 0.60 show the market does not believe the plan. What is not priced is the decision itself. A cut at H1 would break the company's own deferral pattern and hit a crowded margin long (15.6x) that holds for the yield. A hold is roughly neutral to mildly relieving. Probability-weighted, the sign is negative and small.

findings.finding: The 2026-05-14 buyback (up to 1.2m shares, 6.5% of float ex-treasury, ¥4.2bn cap, running to 2026-10-30) hit its share cap and ended on 2026-09-15 at ¥3.68bn. The bid has been gone since, and the stock slid from 3,175 (9/28) to 2,971. Cash is ¥36.9bn against a ¥67.6bn market cap, and 4.79m treasury shares (21%) are held, so a renewal or cancellation in the 10/29 batch is possible but not signalled.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-05-14 print, carrying the buyback announcement, was followed by +7.72%. No buyback came with the H1 2025 print (+0.99%).
findings.why_not_priced: The completion is public, but a renewal is not in the price: the stock has fallen about 6% since the bid ended, and the retail board (Yahoo 掲示板) discusses dividends, not a new buyback. If a renewal were expected, the stock would not have sold off on volume on 10/28. Sized small because the company has never announced a buyback at an H1 print in the record checked (2025-10-30 had none).
findings.independence: Q1 短信 cash 36,921m and treasury shares 4,788,815 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260723598585.pdf); the dividend policy of a 30% payout base with 'stable' dividends (FY26 短信). Same issuer's documents.

outside_window.finding: A full-year cut deferred to the usual April timing (as on 2026-04-13) would land long after this window.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, in line with the -4.7% five-day run-in and slightly building shorts, and against the baseline's mildly positive priced_lean (+0.27). The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY plan plus a renewed buyback or treasury-share cancellation. I looked for it: the buyback ended 9/16, cash is 36.9bn, and nothing has been announced. Together with this name's record of flat-to-up H1 reactions, that keeps the net near zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): shrank the H1-miss finding from -0.8 to -0.4 and moved p_up from 46 to 48. The FY-cut finding stayed at -0.6 because it is something the release would ADD.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (FY held plus buyback renewal) into baseline_tension. I had already searched for it, so the buyback finding was left at +0.3.
